content:
Alex Carter: Heads-up — spike idea: we should sample richer routing traces for tiered customers to help debug fallback churn. thinking about a compact trace payload stored per-request that the console can replay.

Priya Nair: +1. need to balance cost/retention. propose sampling rules: 
- 100% for enterprise (dedicated)
- 5% for hosted paid (per-tenant weighted)
- 0.5% for free/guest
Also keep a lightweight tombstone for every request (ID + routing key) for cross-search.

Marco Ruiz: Agree on sampling tiers. Also we need to capture the full routing decision chain: policy evals, matched pools, chosen variant, and any fallback attempts. Without that it's impossible to debug regressions.

Jen Huang: UX ask: console should allow "replay decision" for a selected request id and show the decision timeline with hoverable headers. Avoid dumping raw logs in the main panel.

Alex Carter: rough trace schema idea (compact):
```
{
  "req_id": "r_123...",
  "ts": 1680000000,
  "origin": "eu-west-1",
  "tier": "standard",
  "decision_path": ["policy:region-check","policy:tier-quota","pool:dedicated-5","variant:ggml-7b-q2"],
  "fallbacks": [{"attempt":1,"variant":"ggml-3b-q2","reason":"capacity_low"}],
  "latency_ms": 110
}
```
(we'd stringify/minify before storing)

Priya Nair: Schema looks good. Add a boolean flag `contains_prompt` set to false by default — only true when we sample for root-cause (and only for enterprise with opt-in) to avoid PII exposure. Also retention policy: tombstones 90d, full-sampled traces 30d.

Marco Ruiz: Telemetry counters to surface: fallback_rate (per-model, per-region, per-tier), avg_latency_delta_when_fallback, cost_delta_estimate, and unique_request_path_count. If fallback_rate spikes, the console should auto-suggest model-variant/quantization changes.

Jen Huang: For rollout UX: when a canary is enabled, show predicted routing delta (how many requests will switch) and preview examples sampled from recent requests (obfuscated). Provide a button: "simulate decision" to run the current policy against a stored tombstone in read-only mode.

sre-oncall: Paging concern — if we route to cheaper variants aggressively during infra pressure, we might hide failures. Need flagging for when fallback is due to capacity vs explicit policy override. Include `fallback_reason` enum: capacity, policy_override, degradation, config_error.

routing-bot: automated note — we already emit headers: `X-Redwood-Routing: tier=standard;region=eu-west-1;variant=ggml-7b-q2;trace_id=r_123`. Suggest adding `X-RW-Fallback=1;reason=capacity_low` when fallback occurs so downstream systems can annotate logs.

Alex Carter: Implementation plan proposal:
1) tombstone write in request path (cheap KV) for every request
2) richer trace write (S3) for sampled requests based on tier policy
3) console: new "Routing traces" panel with search by req_id, tenant, region, model_variant, and quick "simulate" action
4) telemetry job to aggregate counters hourly and surface alerts

Priya Nair: Security needs: encryption at rest, link audit logs to tenant, and an opt-out toggle in tenant settings for storing any prompt text. Also surface TTL and retention in UI.

Marco Ruiz: For rollout, we need an internal API debate: should the simulator call the exact same routing library used in production or a staged config snapshot? If simulator uses live library with pinned config then replay is true-to-prod but might be slow. If staged snapshot, we get faster, reproducible runs. Leaning to staged snapshot for replay.

Jen Huang: UX follow-ups: design will sketch a compact timeline + diff view (pre/post fallback) and hide low-value trace fields behind a "details" expander. Also add "why this match" callouts that link to policy rules.

Alex Carter: action items: Priya to draft retention & sampling config (PR by EOD Thursday), Marco to add trace payload + fallback_reason header (RFC), Jen to prototype timeline UI (Figma link later). I'll wire the tombstone write.

Priya Nair: I'll include suggested defaults and a per-tenant toggle for sampling rate + opt-in for prompt-capture.

Marco Ruiz: RFC note: we should keep trace payload under 2KB after minification to limit cost. Also, consider compressing before S3 write.

sre-oncall: +1 on compression. Also propose alerting rule: if fallback_rate > 5% for paid tiers sustained > 15m, create ops issue and notify eng-runtime.

routing-bot: FYI — added a tiny PoC header in staging: `X-RW-Fallback-Reason` and `X-RW-Trace-Id`. Will push RFC shortly.

Alex Carter: nice. Keeping thread for now — please add comments on the RFC when ready. :thumbsup:
